name: ttd
description: A small helper for the **official** Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) "Special Entry Darshan" site, `https://ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in/`. It runs inside your own browser as a bookmarklet or a userscript (Tampermonkey / Userscripts). It works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on Windows, Mac, Android and iPhone.
